abilities.name: Disintegrate
abilities.description: Argus' abilities apply a stack of Disintegration for 2s, causing subsequent instances of ability damage to deal 4 (+3%) bonus magical damage. Each stack of Disintegration deals 50% more damage, stacking infinitely (capped at 12 against Monsters).

abilities.name: Arcrune Conduit
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing 55 (+55%) physical damage.

abilities.name: Dread Nova
abilities.description: Argus lobs an unstable orb of energy. Upon landing it explodes, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+50%) magical damage to all nearby Targets and Stuns them for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.

abilities.name: Ether Crystal
abilities.description: Argus summons an Ether Crystal at the target location for 2s. The Crystal will Push Enemy Heroes from the center and Lift Allied Heroes into the air before producing a storm that deals 15/25/35/45/55 (+18%) magical damage every 0.5s to nearby Enemies and Slows by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.5s. After the duration the Crystal will implode, Pulling all Enemies within to the center.

abilities.name: Particle Shredder
abilities.description: Argus fires homing projectiles from his Abyssal Staff for up to 3.5s. Each projectile consumes mana and deals 13/20/27/34/41 (+18%) per blast. At maximum rank, Particle Shredder can be used indefinitely.

abilities.name: Synaptic Obliterator
abilities.description: After a short delay, Argus channels for up to 8s, gaining immunity to pushes and pulls whilst deploying his ultimate weapon to fire up to 3/4/5 powerful Energy Beams. Each beam deals 100/130/160 (+25%) magical damage (increased by up to 150% based on the Target's missing health) and Slows Enemies hit by 60% for 0.5s.

augments.name: Arcane Engine
augments.description: Dealing Ability Damage to Heroes grants you 1.75% Movement Speed for 1.5s, stacking infinitely - 0.15s CD.

augments.name: Mana Catalyst
augments.description: Restore Mana equal to 10% of damage dealt to Heroes, reduced to 1.5% for Non-Heroes. Basic Attacks restore 2x more.

augments.name: Infinite Obliteration
augments.description: Synaptic Obliterator's projectile now have infinite range, travel 25% faster, and Slow for 50% longer.

abilities.name: Portal Blast
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing 53.0/54.8/56.6/58.5/60.6/62.7/64.9/67.2/69.6/72.1/74.7/77.4/80.2/83.1/86.0/89.1/92.3/95.5 (+55% physical power) physical damage. Also deals (+2% max mana) magical damage on-hit.

abilities.name: Cosmic Power
abilities.description: Damaging an Enemy Hero with an ability empowers Gideon's next basic attack for 3s, allowing him to attach a cosmic tether to his Target. Tethered Enemies receive 40.0/49.0/58.0/67.0/76.0/85.0/94.0/103.0/112.0/121.0/130.0/139.0/148.0/157.0/166.0/175.0/184.0/193.0 (+9 per level) (+20% magical power) magical damage over 2.1s, after which they are Rooted for 1s. Additionally gain 1% Bonus Maximum Mana per 15 Magical Power.

abilities.name: Cosmic Rift
abilities.description: Rip down a meteor from the sky, dealing 110.0/155.0/200.0/245.0/290.0 (+60% magical power)(+5% max mana) magical damage to all Enemies caught in the area of impact.

abilities.name: Torn Space
abilities.description: Leap through a portal in spacetime, appearing at the target location, gaining (+50.0/75.0/100.0/125.0/150.0 max mana) increased Maximum Mana for 8s. The portal remains open for 5s. Allied Heroes can jump through the portal while it's active. Portal Distance: 800.0/875.0/950.0/1025.0/1100.0u.

abilities.name: Void Breach
abilities.description: Launch forward a comet, dealing 100.0/140.0/180.0/220.0/260.0 (+45% magical power)(+2% max mana) magical damage to all Enemies in its path and Slowing them by 35% for 1.25s. The comet explodes upon hitting an Enemy Hero, Terrain, or at max range. The Cooldown progresses 1% faster per 80 Max Mana.

abilities.name: Black Hole
abilities.description: Unleash a black hole beneath Gideon for 3.5s that slowly drags nearby Enemies towards its center, dealing 520.0/780.0/1040.0 (+250% magical power) magical damage. After channeling for 2.75s, Gideon may act and the Black Hole cannot be cancelled. For each Enemy Hero hit by Black Hole, Gideon gains (+2% max mana) increased Maximum Mana for 8s.

augments.name: Event Horizon
augments.description: Cosmic Rift deals an additional (+5% Target's Max Health) damage to Enemies in the center.

augments.name: Abyssal Mantle
augments.description: Upon activating Black Hole, gain a 50 (+75% magical power) Shield for 4s.
